realtime.description: timing asserts need SITL speed-up 1 (V9); SKIP visibly otherwise

speedup.description: requested SITL --speedup for this run. Default 3; realtime: true pins 1 (and may not combine with speedup > 1). Pin 1 on wall-clock-bound fleets: render-farm/real cameras, world-driven stubs against moving SITL, closed module<->FC loops

tier.description: suite selection tier; absent = regression. `sim suite --tier smoke` runs only the marked fast first-pass set

tasks.description: TeamEngage ids this run file proves (e.g. [SL-0099]) - selectable via `./sim list --task` and `./sim suite --task`

allow_all_skip.description: accept a run whose every assertion SKIPped (otherwise it fails: it proved nothing)

sim.description: SL-0025: the fleet comes from a sims/ file instead of fleet:/transport: - a bare name (copters3), a path relative to the scenario, or {base: <name|path>, with: [overlay, ...]}

transport.description: fake | real, or a sim server: block

link_proxy.description: SL-0009: per-unit byte-level link-fault proxy in front of de_comm (real+auth:false only)

udp_relay.description: TASK-87: spawn the standalone droneengage_udp_proxy next to the comm server (real only); true or {port, udp_port_range, gcs_peer_policy, id, ssl}

home.description: fleet home [lat,lng,alt,yaw]; fleet home:/base: are absolute positions

world.description: world.yaml (P5-08) - accepted, consumed only when P5-08 lands

operation.description: compiled operation (.deop) or a deploy spec / package file

proceed_rules.description: deploy anyway: proceed only when the error findings are exactly these rules (negative controls)

cli.description: override path to the P5-06 verify CLI (verify-op.js)

link_proxy.description: override the transport's link_proxy for this unit

at.description: meters offset from scenario home (alternative to home:/base:)

modules.description: extra modules on top of the class block (P5-08 stubs)

udp_proxy.description: SL-0010: run a chunk-fault UDP proxy on these modules' s2s link (a fault: udp_chunks step injects it itself)

fcb_proxy.description: run the fcb MAVLink proxy between de_mavlink and SITL (SL-0008; enables the fcb_cut/fcb_stall/fcb_corrupt faults)

fcb_link.description: SL-0102/SL-0104/SL-0105/SL-0106: how the FC client reaches the FC - kind tcp (default; with fc_client: external the client dials the proxy on the host's LAN IP); pty: a socat-bridged serial device de_mavlink opens; host_serial: a real host USB-serial adapter bridged to SITL; bt_spp: a host Bluetooth RFCOMM/SPP server bridged to SITL; udp: a socat bridge pushing the proxy's stream to a listening client (hardware/external kinds force fcb_proxy; baud paces the link)

device.description: host_serial only: the host's USB-serial adapter (/dev/ttyUSBn or a /dev/serial/by-id path)

channel.description: bt_spp only: the RFCOMM channel the external client dials

peer.description: udp only: <client-ip>:<port> the bridge pushes to - the client listens, it never sends first

fc_client.description: SL-0104/SL-0105/SL-0106: local (default) | external - no local de_comm/de_mavlink for this unit; its FC client lives off-host on the fcb_link wire (needs fcb_link kind tcp, host_serial, bt_spp or udp)

android.description: SL-0095: the listed modules run inside the Andruav app on an adb-connected phone instead of local procs; serial defaults to ANDROID_SERIAL in sim.local.env

faketime.description: SL-0014: launch de_comm under libfaketime so a clock_step fault can skew its clock at runtime

env.description: SL-0067: per-module launch env {module: {VAR: value}}; DE_BOARD_ID defaults to the unit name; a DE_PROC_STAT_PATH entry spawns a fake_proc_<module> writer fed by <unit>/<module>/cpu_load.json

chaos.description: TASK-10 seeded fault schedule, expanded at load time into timeline fault steps (same seed -> same schedule; docs/SCENARIOS.md)

faults.description: draw pool: a bare kind, or {kind, ...step args} (args: merges too)

units.description: fleet ids the faults may hit (default: the whole fleet)

until_t.description: end of the draw window (default: the timeline's last t)

operator.description: the operator bot's standing policy; keys are approval kinds (launch/action/activate) or target classes

oneOf.description: never answer this kind - the request stays pending (P4F-07)

t.description: seconds from the scenario start; negative = run before the timeline clock starts

world.description: world entity id - watch truth.jsonl world_event rows (SL-0013 react)

fault.description: link_cut|loss|delay|gcs_disconnect|server_down|kill|restart|module_kill|freeze|server_clock|no_time_sync|rc_override|mode|param (set: {NAME: value}) | FC presets: battery|gps_off|gps_jam|gps_glitch|gps_degrade|motor_out|rc_fail|compass_fail|vibration | fcb link (needs fcb_proxy: true): fcb_cut|fcb_stall|fcb_corrupt|fcb_rate (baud) | fcb_unplug (needs fcb_link kind pty/host_serial/bt_spp/udp)

settle_s.description: seconds on: watchers stay armed after the last t: step

render.description: P5-13 opt-in render feed: the world stream (de.worldstream/1 ws on render.stream_port) plus the MAVLink fan-out to Mavlink3DMap (serial4 udpclient -> render.mav_port). Absent = today's headless behaviour, identical ports
